scenarios.title: Repeatable build
scenarios.setup: Fixed compiler, source, lockfile and target profiles.
scenarios.action: Build twice with different filesystem enumeration order.
scenarios.expected: Common artifact hashes match; target plan hashes match their own repeated build.

scenarios.title: Move file without identity change
scenarios.setup: Customer declaration in customers/customer.forge.
scenarios.action: Move to another directory in the same explicit module.
scenarios.expected: Stable symbols, deployment IDs and schemas unchanged.

scenarios.title: Import visibility
scenarios.setup: External package with public and private symbols.
scenarios.action: Import private helper and then an exported type.
scenarios.expected: Private import fails; public import resolves without deployment side effects.

scenarios.title: Enum identity
scenarios.setup: CustomerTier has explicit wire values.
scenarios.expected: Wire values and persisted encoding do not change.

scenarios.title: Duplicate enum wire values
scenarios.setup: Two named enum members use the same string.
scenarios.expected: Stable diagnostic rejects duplicate wire values.

scenarios.title: Lifecycle enum inference
scenarios.setup: Named graph transitions and explicit initial assertion.
scenarios.action: Compile without status field or enum declaration.
scenarios.expected: Order.Status generated once; direct status mutation absent from input schemas.

scenarios.title: Channel directions
scenarios.setup: Send-only and receive-only local capabilities.
scenarios.action: Bind a consumer to send-only; publish to receive-only.
scenarios.expected: Both invalid edges are rejected.

scenarios.title: Missing implementation
scenarios.setup: Application contains custom function without binding.
scenarios.expected: Build fails; check-only contract package can still be inspected.

scenarios.title: Missing external mapping
scenarios.setup: Foreign facility string is wired to a Site reference.
scenarios.expected: Explicit identity resolver required.

scenarios.title: Fixed-point money
scenarios.setup: USD values near precision boundaries.
scenarios.expected: Exact canonical decimal results or explicit overflow; never binary-float drift.

scenarios.title: PATCH omission versus null
scenarios.setup: Record has non-null optional email.
scenarios.expected: First preserves; second clears; defaults are not reapplied.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous date import
scenarios.setup: No locale supplied; cell is 03/04/2026.
scenarios.expected: Ambiguity reported, not guessed.

scenarios.title: Unit normalization
scenarios.setup: Explicit input profile accepts pounds for canonical kg field.
scenarios.action: Normalize vectors on Rust and TS paths.
scenarios.expected: Matching canonical values/rounding policy and errors.

scenarios.title: Key encoding collisions
scenarios.setup: Keys contain separators, Unicode, varying lengths and numbers.
scenarios.expected: No collisions; order agrees with Forge comparator.

scenarios.title: Reference versus record
scenarios.setup: Input field is Customer reference, output is Customer.Record.
scenarios.action: Pass a record where reference required.
scenarios.expected: Strict declared representation is enforced; no implicit database lookup.

scenarios.title: Basic vertical slice
scenarios.setup: Empty Acme tenant.
scenarios.action: Create Customer, create Site, list, update and read with unchanged client.
scenarios.expected: Equivalent canonical records, revisions and errors on both clouds.

scenarios.title: Concurrent unique create
scenarios.setup: Two creates use same canonical customer code.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one succeeds; one uniqueness conflict; one live claim owner.

scenarios.title: Tenant-isolated uniqueness
scenarios.setup: Same customer code in Acme and another tenant.
scenarios.expected: Both succeed; no cross-tenant reads or reference resolution.

scenarios.title: Versioned update race
scenarios.setup: Two updates expect the same version.
scenarios.expected: One mutation commits; the other reports a precondition conflict.

scenarios.title: Missing HTTP precondition
scenarios.setup: Versioned record and authenticated client.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 428 with stable problem details.

scenarios.title: Stale HTTP precondition
scenarios.setup: Record advanced since read.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 412; no success audit or outbox event.

scenarios.title: Immutable and server fields
scenarios.setup: Resource has code, timestamps and tenant context.
scenarios.action: Try patching code, version, createdAt or tenantId.
scenarios.expected: Forbidden field assignment rejected; no partial mutation.

scenarios.title: Reference delete race
scenarios.setup: Parent Customer and pending Site creation.
scenarios.action: Race Site creation with parent deletion.
scenarios.expected: No committed orphan; one side is restricted/conflicted as specified.

scenarios.title: Related-record guard race
scenarios.setup: Order rule requires matching Site.customer.
scenarios.action: Race rule-dependent write with allowed Site change.
scenarios.expected: Invariant holds or mutation fails, never check-then-write corruption.

scenarios.title: Soft-delete key retention
scenarios.setup: Soft-deleted Customer with unique code.
scenarios.expected: Conflict until explicit purge under default policy.

scenarios.title: Restore integrity
scenarios.setup: Deleted record and surviving parent/unique relationships.
scenarios.expected: Guarded restoration preserves uniqueness and reference rules.

scenarios.title: Lifecycle bypass
scenarios.setup: Draft Order.
scenarios.action: Patch status directly; then call allowed submit command.
scenarios.expected: Patch rejected; command applies one legal transition.

scenarios.title: Illegal lifecycle jump
scenarios.setup: Draft Order.
scenarios.expected: InvalidState conflict, no partial business mutation.

scenarios.title: D1 zero-row conditional update
scenarios.setup: Stale expected version in a multi-write mutation.
scenarios.expected: No record, audit, receipt or outbox success is committed.

scenarios.title: Lost success response
scenarios.setup: Mutation committed; transport response dropped.
scenarios.action: Retry same idempotency key and payload.
scenarios.expected: Original logical result returned; no duplicate effects.

scenarios.title: Idempotency key payload conflict
scenarios.setup: Completed request receipt exists.
scenarios.expected: Explicit conflict; no new mutation.

scenarios.title: Physical budget enforcement
scenarios.setup: Changeset expands to too many claims/access items.
scenarios.expected: Rejected before partial writes; preview reports physical budget issue.

scenarios.title: Resumable bulk partial conflict
scenarios.setup: 100 row import; 2 stale revisions.
scenarios.expected: 98 logical successes and 2 conflicts; replay does not repeat successes.

scenarios.title: Strong named query
scenarios.setup: Record newly created or moved between indexed values.
scenarios.expected: Completed changes observable under declared strong profile; no GSI-only plan.

scenarios.title: Sequential keyset pagination
scenarios.setup: Static records with equal primary sort value.
scenarios.expected: Stable tie-breaker yields each record once in defined order.

scenarios.title: Cursor tenant tamper
scenarios.setup: Cursor from tenant A.
scenarios.action: Use in tenant B or alter query parameters.
scenarios.expected: Rejected or treated as invalid; no data disclosure.

scenarios.title: Bounded work on filtered pages
scenarios.setup: Customer query has many rows rejected by view filter.
scenarios.action: Request page with a work budget.
scenarios.expected: Returns valid continuation even when result page empty; no hidden unbounded scan.

scenarios.title: Unsupported unbounded join
scenarios.setup: Portable view needs unbounded relational grouping.
scenarios.expected: Requires a projection/reviewed bounded strategy; no silent backend downgrade.

scenarios.title: Commit-before-publish crash
scenarios.setup: Mutation commits outbox record.
scenarios.expected: Later reconciliation publishes without losing the logical event.

scenarios.title: Publish-before-receipt crash
scenarios.setup: Broker accepted message.
scenarios.action: Crash before marking outbox delivery complete.
scenarios.expected: Possible redelivery, but consumer business effect deduplicates.

scenarios.title: Broadcast independent subscriptions
scenarios.setup: Two subscribers, one fails.
scenarios.action: Publish event and recover failed subscriber.
scenarios.expected: Each gets its logical event; failed subscriber does not lose delivery or corrupt completed subscriber.

scenarios.title: Out-of-order revisions
scenarios.setup: Events for same record arrive version 4 before 3.
scenarios.expected: Version 3 does not overwrite version 4.

scenarios.title: Poison message
scenarios.setup: Malformed or permanently invalid event.
scenarios.expected: Quarantine/DLQ with sanitized diagnostics; healthy messages continue.

scenarios.title: Binding ownership
scenarios.setup: Imported payment channel has no physical endpoint.
scenarios.expected: Fail before mutation; no arbitrary subscription or resource creation.

scenarios.title: Upload finalization
scenarios.setup: Valid direct upload into staging object.
scenarios.expected: Readable ObjectRef points to approved immutable content.

scenarios.title: Staging overwrite after review
scenarios.setup: Client retains valid staging upload URL.
scenarios.expected: Approved sealed bytes cannot change.

scenarios.title: Claimed size/type mismatch
scenarios.setup: Small-file declaration but oversized/disallowed upload.
scenarios.expected: Rejected from ready state; cleanup eligible; no downstream approved-content event.

scenarios.title: Duplicate object notification
scenarios.setup: Same uploaded object notification repeated.
scenarios.expected: One logical finalized upload/process job.

scenarios.title: Quoted multiline CSV
scenarios.setup: CSV contains quoted newlines, delimiters, CRLF and BOM.
scenarios.expected: No dropped, duplicated, or split logical records.

scenarios.title: Whole-file duplicate keys
scenarios.setup: Duplicates separated by many chunks.
scenarios.expected: Whole-file uniqueness error found, not only chunk-local validation.

scenarios.title: Source replay protects later edits
scenarios.setup: Import accepted; record later edited in UI.
scenarios.expected: New proposal with conflicts/diff; no silent overwrite.

scenarios.title: Logical expiration before cleanup
scenarios.setup: Expired cache item still physically present.
scenarios.expected: Runtime rejects as fresh regardless of provider TTL deletion timing.

scenarios.title: Effective boundary rollover
scenarios.setup: Current policy changes before default TTL.
scenarios.expected: Old policy cannot remain fresh past the boundary.

scenarios.title: Global invalidation race
scenarios.setup: Invalidation concurrent with an old in-flight loader.
scenarios.expected: Revision/epoch guard prevents old result being treated as fresh.

scenarios.title: Loader dependency failure
scenarios.setup: Cache expired and origin unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Uses explicitly allowed stale window or returns declared error; never indefinite stale fallback.

scenarios.title: Adjacent intervals
scenarios.setup: Existing [a,b) interval.
scenarios.expected: Valid nonoverlap on both backends.

scenarios.title: Concurrent overlapping intervals
scenarios.setup: Empty effective group.
scenarios.expected: At most one commits.

scenarios.title: Concurrent cycle creation
scenarios.setup: A and B are independent nodes.
scenarios.action: Move A under B concurrently with B under A.
scenarios.expected: Cycle never commits.

scenarios.title: Move preserves identity
scenarios.setup: Node with children and references.
scenarios.expected: Business IDs and references unchanged; traversal obeys declared bounds.

scenarios.title: Replay of contribution event
scenarios.setup: Projection has applied event once.
scenarios.expected: No double-counted aggregate.

scenarios.title: Generation rebuild
scenarios.setup: Write fence/quiescence established for baseline rebuild.
scenarios.action: Rebuild into new generation, validate, switch.
scenarios.expected: Readers see old or complete new generation, not partially built state.

scenarios.title: Duplicate start
scenarios.setup: Same logical workflow start delivered repeatedly.
scenarios.expected: One logical execution or explicitly deduplicated equivalent, not repeated business effects.

scenarios.title: Signal before wait
scenarios.setup: Payment arrives before workflow has registered wait.
scenarios.action: Persist signal and later reach wait.
scenarios.expected: Signal consumed once from inbox; not lost.

scenarios.title: Timeout-signal race
scenarios.setup: Wait deadline coincides with authorized signal.
scenarios.expected: One terminal wait outcome; no double completion.

scenarios.title: Retried external side effect
scenarios.setup: Provider call succeeds but response is lost.
scenarios.action: Retry activity with same operation identity.
scenarios.expected: Provider idempotency used; absent strategy triggers unsupported safety claim.

scenarios.title: Workflow version pinning
scenarios.setup: Old execution waiting during new deployment.
scenarios.expected: Continues under pinned compatible graph/implementation.

scenarios.title: UTC recurrence equivalence
scenarios.setup: Canonical schedule with named weekdays.
scenarios.expected: Same intended occurrence instants.

scenarios.title: DST recurrence equivalence
scenarios.setup: Local-time schedule spanning missing/repeated hours.
scenarios.expected: Same intended occurrences/deduplication on both targets.

scenarios.title: Reconnect protocol
scenarios.setup: Authenticated connection drops mid-update.
scenarios.action: Reconnect and resume from logical cursor/version.
scenarios.expected: Defined replay/resync behavior; no cross-tenant message leakage.

scenarios.title: SLO expected versus infrastructure errors
scenarios.setup: Known business rejection plus dependency timeout.
scenarios.expected: Classification matches explicit eligibility policy; timeout does not become a good event.

scenarios.title: Trace sampling independence
scenarios.setup: Sampling drops most spans.
scenarios.expected: SLI accounting uses separate unsampled metric/event path; export gaps visible.

scenarios.title: Metric cardinality and redaction
scenarios.setup: Inputs contain IDs, email, secrets.
scenarios.expected: No unbounded/private default metric labels; safe trace attributes only.

scenarios.title: Codec tightening
scenarios.setup: Existing records violate new bound.
scenarios.expected: Backfill/validation required; no silent destructive migration.

scenarios.title: D1 SQL runtime swap
scenarios.setup: Same application using Effect SQL then Drizzle.
scenarios.action: Run same fixtures and mutation histories.
scenarios.expected: No public schema or semantic change.

scenarios.title: Provider cutover
scenarios.setup: Fenced writes, canonical export with blob manifest.
scenarios.action: Import into other provider and validate.
scenarios.expected: Same IDs/revisions/canonical values; derived state rebuilt; in-flight workflows explicitly handled.
